mairie.name: La mairie · Town Hall
mairie.alt: The village town hall painted in ink and gouache: a yellow dress with an address tag on a coat stand, a framed photo of a smiling toe, a green bin with a bell, three eels queueing with a ticket, an ID card driving a red go-kart, Monsieur Verbe waiting beside a sun-tanned dragon in sunglasses, signing at a lectern with a quill and writing on a long scroll, the mayor mare in a tricolour sash with golden scissors, a flag draped over a stool, a donkey in glasses at his desk, a girl in a yellow raincoat showing a passport at a rainy window, a boy with a bouquet and a pocket watch and a gnome with a name badge; the open front door on the left leads to the village a blue door on the right leads to the post office and a teal double door in the back wall opens onto the council chamber; behind the horse a half-open teal door shows the archive drawers.

doors.label: La poste
doors.hint: Through the blue door to the post office

doors.label: La salle du conseil
doors.hint: Through the teal double door to the council chamber

doors.label: Les archives
doors.hint: Through the half-open teal door behind the horse to the town archives

zooms.label: le bureau
zooms.hint: Look at what is on the donkey's desk

bureau.name: Le bureau · Office
bureau.alt: Close-up of the donkey's desk, cut from the town hall painting: the mayor mare's sash and golden scissors at the left, the grey donkey in glasses writing with a quill, an inkwell, a letter sealed with a red heart, a key made of orange clay standing in its lump, a lop-eared bunny licking an envelope shut, a stamp showing a tambourine, a stylish pen with a pink scarf and the gnome's red hat peeking in.

poste.name: La poste · Post Office
poste.alt: The village post office painted in ink and gouache: a teal door back to the town hall, a calendar with a dart in one square, a smiling cassette wearing a postman's cap, an easel with a poster of an orange fish, a suitcase on a red leash, the post-office counter, Monsieur Verbe throwing a paper-plane letter, calling on an apple held to his ear and wrapping a parcel in a pink tutu, a red telephone bouncing on a table, a ticket machine with three children waiting in a row, a collie carrying a parcel, a cardboard box on wheels carrying a heavy weight and a bundle of letters sprinting in running shoes.

doors.label: La mairie
doors.hint: Back through the teal door to the town hall

zooms.label: le guichet
zooms.hint: Look at what is on the post-office counter

guichet.name: Le guichet · Counter
guichet.alt: Close-up of the post-office counter in front of its brass grille: a sheet of writing paper shaped like a leaf, a cello with string wound round its neck, a blue kettle wearing a brown label, a banana tied with a red ribbon, an open red present full of soft modelling dough and a little packet giving an OK sign.

conseil.name: La salle du conseil · Council Chamber
conseil.alt: The town council chamber painted in ink and gouache: a woman pulls the cord of a ceiling fan, a goat walks along the bench tops, a grandpa holds up a hand to stop a duckling, a smiling councillor holds up one single salmon, a donkey brays at a surprised man, a councillor bangs a gavel, a bearded man waits his turn holding one big pink sweet, a jug overflows a glass while a bald man raises his hand, Ann shows a young man how to fold a ballot into the box, a grey-haired lady works a shrugging hand puppet; the teal double door on the left leads back to the town hall and the arched alcove on the right opens onto the councillors' gallery; a narrow arched doorway in the back wall gives a glimpse of the civic hall's open day.

doors.label: La mairie
doors.hint: Back through the teal double door to the town hall

zooms.label: la tribune
zooms.hint: Look up into the councillors' gallery in the alcove

zooms.label: les associations
zooms.hint: Peek through the narrow arched doorway into the civic hall

tribune.name: La tribune · Councillors' Gallery
tribune.alt: Close-up of the councillors' gallery in the chamber alcove: a lady with an umbrella at a rainy window, a knight holding up ten fingers, a video man filming a cat beside a pie, a snail crossing a finish ribbon, a sleeping councillor whose wig slides down, a ginger councillor banging his fist so the inkpots jump, a boy called Dan with a saucepan and a biscuit, a striped strongman diving to catch a falling jug, a grey-haired lady holding up a blank certificate and a vase of roses with one dahlia.

archives.name: Les archives · Town Archives
archives.alt: The town archives painted in ink and gouache: a young man waves a small black-red-gold flag, a cool archivist in sunglasses shows two children a lute and a lace fan, a baker leans in through the window with a basket of baguettes, a man pins picture postcards on a globe, an archivist opens Russian nesting dolls as the smallest vanishes in a puff, a girl files windmill postcards into a drawer, a woman opens a big book tied with a blue-white-red ribbon, a waffle carries a tiny black-yellow-red flag, a young man in a navy coat holds an Eiffel Tower postcard, a gondolier in a straw boater sings with a rolled map, a spaniel dances with hand bells and a traveller carries a sticker-covered suitcase; the teal door on the left leads back to the town hall and the arched doorway on the right looks into the map room.

doors.label: La mairie
doors.hint: Back through the teal door to the town hall

zooms.label: la salle des cartes
zooms.hint: Look through the arched doorway into the map room

cartes.name: La salle des cartes · Map Room
cartes.alt: The archives map room painted in ink and gouache: a general covered in medals sorts colour-coded folders, a boy turns the dial on a giant globe, a girl waves a paper fan under a red Chinese lantern beside a little dragon, an official in a sash bangs a giant rubber stamp, a woman folds a flag into a box, a green parrot squawks from a teak podium, a man holds a map of a winding river beside a carved giraffe, a young woman files a prairie map and a bison postcard, a party guest lines up shoe boxes by size, a drawer spills a compass, a feather, a key and flippers, a fox family snuggles in a den under the table while children peek in, a corgi in a tiny crown sits on a velvet cushion and a friendly uncle chats with a queue.

civique.name: La salle des associations · Civic Hall
civique.alt: Close-up of the civic hall's open day, seen through the narrow arched doorway of the council chamber: a lady dressed as the Statue of Liberty holding up a torch, club ladies in flowered hats, balloons popping over a crowd being counted, a lady handing out matching socks, a lady holding a giant onion tied with a ribbon, a girl dancing alone with a ribbon, neighbours watering a shared vegetable planter, two girls level on a seesaw, a man in a flat cap waving a red flag toward a painted sunrise, a man raising his right hand with a giant pencil at an easel, a man showing a blank membership card with a rosette, a man holding an umbrella over a leaky kitten shelter, three men in matching tartan kilts, and, roped off on a dark marble pedestal, a plain framed blank museum plaque.
